rapport_notes: Extremely patient with a very detailed, rambling 21-item inventory list; complimented the customer's thoroughness and handled several tangential questions (weather policy, TV boxes, fees) warmly.

evidence_quotes.agenda: "let's talk about your move. What are your biggest concerns, what are the most important things you want answers on this call today?" — asked after basic contact info but before detailed logistics/inventory probing.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: "Do you provide like a cushion, blankets and so forth to protect the furniture?" was answered directly ("Yes, we provide everything... included in the hourly rate") with no deeper follow-up question back.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: "the most important [factor] is how well prepared you are when we get there... the last time we take, the last money you end up spending" (self-prep tip) plus "I'd like to reiterate this is just an estimate and at the end of the day you'll only be billed for actual hours rendered."

top_strength: Rare full self-prep-tip delivery plus thorough, patient handling of an unusually detailed customer — call abruptly disconnects right after securing a verbal yes to book.
coaching_note: Communication differentiator (day-before call/named crew lead) never covered, and "does that feel fair" + silence checkpoint was skipped before the close.
